content.short: Surya is a set of utilities for exploring Solidity contracts.
content.description: Surya is a ConsenSys tool named to reflect its focus on Solidity. It provides a visual representation of a Solidity smart contract's underlying structure. The project is licensed under the GPL-3 license, and hundreds of smart contract developers actively use it.
content.meta: Surya is a set of utilities for exploring Solidity contracts. Discover Surya and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
